instruction: My last 2 amazon orders were for my roommates and me. The total cost is to be equally shared among all of us. Make venmo requests, one for each of my roommates, with a description note, "For Shared Purchases on Amazon" and their share of the expense.
notes: Roommates are discovered via phone.search_contacts with relationship="roommate"; a single search call sets (roommates-found), gating knowledge of the statically declared roommate emails. The problem assumes two roommates (matching the 9-call reference solution); add more person/email objects and extend the goal/complete-task if there are more. The per-roommate share is a single runtime amount object computed from the two most recent amazon orders (sort by order date descending; if show_orders does not expose totals, amazon.show_order can be called per order) divided by roommates+1. venmo.create_payment_request is called once per roommate with the fixed description; the private flag is not used. supervisor-complete-task takes the two distinct roommates as non-API record parameters so its precondition covers every goal condition; it is called with no answer.

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'app', 'password', 'username', 'email', 'token', 'relationship', 'description', 'amount', 'person'}
